records.source: How each spot's barcode is read, in the OPS and spacer-prefix decodes. 'log' reads the -LoG-filtered pixels (3 x 3 maximum) and calls bases after the per-cycle median normalisation. 'raw' reads the unfiltered pixels (maximum within 3 px) and calls the brightest channel as read, with no normalisation, unmixing or library calibration (PERISCOPE's read). 'auto' picks 'log' or 'raw' per well from decoy calls, tuned with ops_decode_threshold_mode 'auto' or ops_prefix_threshold_tuning 'per_well_decoy'. Spots are found the same way in every mode. Default 'log'. Alpha.
records.translation: 在 OPS 解码和间隔序列前缀解码中如何读取每个斑点的条形码。'log' 读取经 LoG 滤波的像素（3 x 3 最大值），并在每个循环的中位数归一化之后判定碱基。'raw' 读取未经滤波的像素（3 px 范围内的最大值），按读取到的原样判定最亮的通道，不做归一化、解混或文库校准（PERISCOPE 的读取方式）。'auto' 根据诱饵判定为每个样本位置选择 'log' 或 'raw'，与 ops_decode_threshold_mode 'auto' 或 ops_prefix_threshold_tuning 'per_well_decoy' 一同调节。每种模式下斑点的检测方式相同。默认值 'log'。Alpha。
